meta.purpose: R-23. Suggested improvements to this site and to the decision process, each with the reasoning, the effort and a recommendation, so a reviewer can choose a path before anything is implemented. Nothing here is implemented — that is the point of the section.

improvements.title: Add a live price-discovery module driven by the three written quotes
improvements.problem: The site can show a formula but not a price. Price is the dock the whole decision turns on.
improvements.proposal: Once G-08 closes, add a page where each of the three quotes is entered with its assumed cap rate and term, and the site ranks them against the hold case automatically. Results stay browser-only so no confidential bid ever reaches the repo.
improvements.decision_enabled: Turns 'what are we offered' into 'which offer beats holding'

improvements.title: Add a document register with hashes, not documents
improvements.problem: R-03 needs a lease abstract but the lease cannot live here.
improvements.proposal: Publish only a register: document type, date, verified/unverified, and a SHA-256 hash of the offline file so an adviser can prove which version was abstracted. The hash proves integrity without disclosing content.

improvements.title: Turn the notice calendar into the site's clock
improvements.problem: The single cheapest way to lose money on a ground lease is to miss a notice window.
improvements.proposal: A page that counts down to each dated obligation once the lease date is known, with the guard that it renders nothing until G-01 closes rather than guessing a date.

improvements.title: Add a scenario comparison matrix (base / adverse / severe)
improvements.problem: The site states risks but does not let a reviewer see three futures side by side.
improvements.proposal: Three columns built entirely from the verified observations already in this repo — for example base case uses the observed +0.19% two-year job change, adverse uses the 2020 unemployment peak of 18.9% as a shock, severe adds the correlated hazard legs. All inputs are already sourced; no new data needed.
improvements.decision_enabled: Makes the tail visible without inventing probabilities

improvements.title: Add a comparable-transactions tracker against the County recorder
improvements.problem: I-04 says no verified comp set exists. The County recorder makes one possible for free.
improvements.proposal: A table of recorded grant deeds for single-tenant QSR parcels in Los Angeles County, with the documentary transfer tax implied price, each row linked to the recorder's index. Populated manually as research proceeds.
improvements.decision_enabled: Replaces the unverified short-lease discount with real transactions
improvements.recommendation: Adopt — highest value per unit of effort on this list

improvements.title: Add a sensitivity tornado chart to the calculator
improvements.problem: The owner cannot see which input actually matters.
improvements.proposal: Rank each input's swing on the net after-tax number, so it becomes obvious that term and basis dominate and that small rent differences do not.
improvements.decision_enabled: Focuses advisers on the gates that matter

improvements.title: Separate 'verified' from 'reasoned' with a hard visual rule
improvements.problem: Everything on a decision site looks equally trustworthy.
improvements.proposal: Two visual states only: a green VERIFIED badge with a Tier 1 link, or a red UNVERIFIED badge with an empty value. Never a third, softer state. Already applied by convention; make it a build-time check.
improvements.decision_enabled: Prevents the site itself from becoming a source of false confidence
improvements.recommendation: Adopt now — already partially enforced by tools/check.py

improvements.title: Add a balanced red-team comparison
improvements.problem: Any decision-support analysis can anchor the reader toward one path.
improvements.proposal: Present the strongest verified case and strongest counter-case for each sale, renewal and deferral path, with source-linked evidence and explicit unknowns, so reviewers can challenge the assumptions before deciding.
improvements.decision_enabled: Guards against anchor bias on a large irreversible decision

improvements.title: Add an access-controlled internal companion, separate from this repo
improvements.problem: This repo must stay public-safe, which means it can never hold the real records.
improvements.proposal: A private, access-logged workspace for [LEASE-FILE], [TAX-RETURNS] and quotes, with this site linking to nothing but a policy statement. Keep the public site aggregate-only, permanently.
improvements.decision_enabled: Lets the analysis use real documents without publishing them
improvements.recommendation: Adopt before any document is shared
improvements.risk: Medium if done casually, low if done properly

improvements.title: Add a decision log
improvements.problem: After six months nobody remembers why a choice was made.
improvements.proposal: An append-only page recording each decision, the date, the gates that were closed at the time, and the evidence relied on. Nothing is ever edited, only appended.
improvements.decision_enabled: Makes the reasoning auditable and reversible

choose_a_path.instruction: Pick one of the three paths below. They are ordered by effort, and each is independent of the others.

paths.name: Minimum responsible build
paths.gets_you: A trustworthy, auditable, non-misleading site that cannot be mistaken for a valuation.

paths.name: Decision-grade build
paths.effort: One to two weeks of adviser time plus build
paths.gets_you: A site that can actually host the sell-versus-hold decision once the gates close.

paths.name: Evidence-grade build
paths.effort: One to two months of record research at the County recorder
paths.gets_you: Real transaction evidence replacing the unverified short-lease discount. This is the only path that produces a defensible price without buying commercial data.

choose_a_path.recommendation: Take P-A immediately — it costs almost nothing and prevents the most damaging failure mode, which is a confident-looking site built on unknowns. Commit to P-C in parallel, because the comparable-transactions tracker is the only route to a verified price that does not require purchasing data. P-B is the natural landing point while P-C accumulates.
